summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new Ciberseguridad Modo 1 (Observación Pasiva) product. 9/9 pytest tests passed covering /api/ciber/herramientas, /api/ciber/dominios, /api/ciber/modo1/config (valid + 404), /api/ciber/modo1/analizar (embudo demo, api_webhook Splunk payload, invalid domain 400), and /api/ciber/modo1/historial. Frontend /ciberseguridad renders 4 tools, 6 empresas selector, embudo/api_webhook toggle. 'Ejecutar observación pasiva' produces the result block with all data-testid subcomponents (metricas, tendencia-svg, heatmap, top-ventanas, reporte). API/webhook flow accepts JSON payload and returns results. Selecting Modo 2 shows the 'Próximamente' notice.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1950 lines — recommend splitting the ciber router into its own module (routers/ciber.py) to keep <700 lines per file.
The dead loop 'for d in empresas: d = d  # noqa' at ciber_dominios can be removed (no effect).
Numpy RuntimeWarnings from the MOCG codec (cov with 1 event) are benign but noisy; consider suppressing with np.errstate in compresion_geometrica.
info_config hardcodes formatos_soportados; consider centralizing the list next to parse_siem dispatch to avoid drift.
seed_data_creation: MOCG memoria entries were created under /app/backend/flujo/ciber_memoria/dom_hotel_v1/ from analizar calls (test artifacts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ciber Modo 1 is fully green. Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_ciber_modo1.py. Endpoints: /api/ciber/{herramientas,dominios,modo1/config,modo1/analizar,modo1/historial/{domain_id}}. Frontend route /ciberseguridad with component CiberModo1.jsx uses testids ciber-*. Demo embudo (no files) produces synthetic deterministic data with seed.
